summary.claim: Historical pressure-performance indicator; persistence not demonstrated. Its ability to predict IPL 2027 is not established (D15).
exec_summary: We rated 45 batters, 71 bowlers and 8 all-rounders on how they performed when a ball could swing the match (IPL 2023–26).
RR's measured gaps: middle-overs batting, death-overs batting under pressure; RR's bowling under pressure is above league in every phase.
Must-Back if available: Ashutosh Sharma, Matheesha Pathirana, Patrick Cummins. Plan A in an assumed Rs 15 cr purse: Vyshak Kumar, Abdul Samad, Venkatesh Iyer, Ashutosh Sharma.
Honest test: the score did not beat a naive ranking at predicting next season (batters 57.1% v 50.0%; bowlers 64.7% v 84.2%).
So read it as proof of past pressure performance, not a promise; prices, ages and availability are unverified assumptions to recheck before 16 Dec.

squad_still_lacks: Even with Plan A, RR's measured weakness is middle-overs batting under pressure; the picks narrow the gap but no option in an assumed Rs 15 cr purse closes it with certainty.
